items.html: And this is what is said of the people of Sodom: “And the Lord rained upon Sodom, from the Lord, out of heaven.” For the principal conduct is from heaven, which is ZA. However, because the Nukva was also included in the three upper of the NHY of ZA, she is therefore mentioned together with him, as it says, “And the Lord rained, etc., He and His court.”
